title: Second divergent copy of the hand-rolled minimal-DOM harness now lives in form_stepper.test.js
evidence: form_stepper.test.js:20 `// ---------- Minimal DOM (mirrors apply_analytics.test.js) ----------` followed by `let idSeq = 0` / `function el(tag, attrs = {}, children = []) {`; apply_analytics.test.js:124 `// ---------- Minimal DOM for section rules ----------` followed by the same `let idSeq = 0` / `function el(tag, attrs = {}, children = []) {`. The two copies have already diverged: form_stepper.test.js's version adds `node.setAttribute = (k, v) => {`, `node.closest = (selector) => {`, compound-selector handling (`if (selector.indexOf(",") !== -1)`) and selectors (`.form-field`, `[data-gating-message]`, bare tags) that apply_analytics.test.js's `matches()` does not support.
detail: AGENTS.md mandates DRY at 2+ repetitions. The fake-DOM (`el`/`matches`/`section`/`textInput`) is now maintained in two places with silently different selector semantics; a fix or a third consumer will drift them further.
recommended_fix: Extract the harness into a shared CommonJS helper (e.g. scripts/js-tests/fake_dom.js) required by both test files, with the extended selector set as the single implementation.
